axis: a complexity that confuses → a knot of unresolvable, unwelcome choice

members.tone: Names both the trouble and the confusion together, and locates the cause in complexity rather than in the person confused.
The plain word for what defeats understanding outright, and the one that can carry wonder alongside the bafflement rather than only frustration.
Formal, and frames the inexplicable thing as a posed puzzle rather than the open blankness of *mystery*.
Casts what cannot be explained as something withheld, as though understanding were being kept from you rather than simply out of reach.
Idiomatic and flat: shut to understanding with none of the allure *mystery* can carry, and no expectation of opening.
The confusion pictured as physically knotted, so the exasperation is with the mess itself rather than with any difficulty of thought.
Harsher than *tangle* - a jumble pulled tight, sounding hostile and past unpicking.
Makes the jumble something you are inside and lost in, with an intricacy *tangle* does not suggest.
Puts the weight on the shape of the trap - two branches, neither of them good - so the uncertainty has a hard structure to it.
Softer than *dilemma*, dwelling on the wavering state of the person stuck rather than on how bad the options are.
